approximation_limits: Raw density omits caves, aquifers, decoration and actual chunk interpolation.
Sea-level uncertainty includes the observed five-block predictor height error.
One-block coast samples remain density predictions, not exact liquid blocks.
Discovery/refinement budgets can miss islands; deferred components are reported.
Deep Dark and ocean biome coverage are hints, not exact terrain proofs.

chunkbase_review.notes: Fresh positional holdout at negative coordinates on an upper-bit seed. Terrain shows a compact separated forest island with broad usable gently rolling ground, small raised areas, beach and ocean around it; clearing/leveling is needed and it is not the strict dry flat mountain-basin branch. Nearby mainland forests are visible. Required markers are comfortably inside both squares; Fortress crossing offset is+3,+3 from native(-472,-856), the established coordinate convention. No actual-game/tree/footprint claims. Fresh optimization follow-up re-confirms both required markers in matching-version actual UI and the ocean-island control. Prior holdout classification is historical, not a newly blind sample.
